# Bold design reference

## Contents

- [Use](#use)
- [Style foundations](#style-foundations)

## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Style foundations

- Visual style: bold
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Archivo
  Black, display=Archivo Black, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300,
  400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, secondary | Tokens: primary=#0077BC,
  secondary=#009866, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626,
  surface=#111111, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: friendly, professional.

## Design intent

Strong visual presence with heavyweight typography, high-contrast colors, and
commanding layouts.
